visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and glasses, wearing a dark grey t-shirt, sits on a beige tiled floor in a modern living room setting. He holds a small silver metal bowl and interacts with a small black and tan Chihuahua puppy. Background elements include a white wire pet enclosure and a white storage box. (2) The man points toward a white digital scale on the floor; the puppy walks onto the scale and stands still. Lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor home environment. (3) The man performs a series of hand gestures: he holds up a palm for a 'high five' which the puppy taps, and then points a finger 'gun' saying 'biu', causing the puppy to lie on its side. (4) Close-up shots capture the puppy's face and paws as it touches the man's hand and receives small treats. The man's hands are prominent as he guides the puppy's movements. (5) The man circles his hand above the puppy, leading it to spin in place. The puppy's ears are perked up and its tail is wagging. (6) The puppy stands on its hind legs to place its paws on the man's forearm while he praises it. (7) The puppy goes back to the scale to sit obediently while the man continues to speak and gesture. (8) The video concludes with the puppy sitting perfectly still, highlighted by animated white sparkle graphics and variety-show style text overlays appearing around it.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A friendly and high-energy male voice introduces the Chihuahua puppy named Jibao in Mandarin. Upbeat acoustic guitar music with a bright, percussive rhythm begins immediately at approximately 110 BPM. (2) A sharp 'ding' bell-like sound effect triggers as the puppy successfully performs its first trick. The voice continues with enthusiastic praise. (3) A cartoonish 'pop' or 'bubble' SFX accompanies a command for the puppy to play dead, followed by another 'ding' upon success. (4) Faint metallic clinking is audible as the man moves a silver treat bowl. (5) Throughout the sequence, recurring magic-sparkle and bell chime SFX punctuate each successful command ('sit', 'spin', 'high-five'). (6) The background music remains continuous and upbeat, maintaining a cheerful atmosphere without pauses. (7) The recording concludes with a final loud 'ding' SFX and a warm, positive closing remark from the speaker.
